_readme: S359 SkyMoss, 2026-10-10, second read. The first (rcc_liberal_arts_emphases, run 38092150229) found six of the seven emphasis degrees in Riverside City's Degrees and Certificates Index, each titled as cq_is_program() reads a program (6290 "Math and Science - Associate of Science - AS493/AS493C", 6284 "Administration and Information Systems - Associate of Arts Degree - AA494/AA494C"). So the walk reaches them, and assign() finds no candidate on their pages: none names half the courses the Program Course File lists (110 for Math & Sciences). This read loads the Math and Science entry two ways, its view with "network": true (does a further call carry the course lists?) and its _getPage JSON (how the requirements are written there), and the Administration and Information Systems _getPage JSON beside it. Three page loads, no model call.

questions.page_source: Which call delivers an emphasis degree's course lists, and whether _getPage holds them.
questions.page_shape: How the emphasis requirements are written: a course list per area, a pointer to the GE pattern, or a list of disciplines.
